title: Direct Scattering for the KdV Equation with a Step-like Finite-Gap Potential: A Riemann--Hilbert Approach
summary: We develop the direct scattering theory for the KdV equation with step-like finite-gap backgrounds under perturbations. More precisely, we consider initial data that asymptotically approach two distinct one-gap periodic travelling wave solutions as \(x \to \pm \infty\). Under suitable assumptions on the perturbation, we formulate the direct scattering problem and establish the analytic structure of the associated scattering data.
